items: 【Space-Saving L-Shaped & Versatile Layout】 This 5-piece patio furniture set forms a sleek L-shape, perfectly fitting into corners or small outdoor spaces like balconies, backyards, and porches. The modular design includes a 3-seat sofa, a comfortable ottoman, and a coffee table—offering flexible seating for gatherings or a cozy spot for one to relax.

【Premium All-Weather Black Rattan Construction】 Crafted with durable black PE wicker and a sturdy powder-coated steel frame, this sectional sofa is built to last. Resistant to UV rays, water, rust, and cracking, it maintains its sleek black finish and structural integrity through all weather conditions, ensuring long-term outdoor use.

【Cloud-Like Comfort with High-Density Cushions】 Sink into plush, high-density foam cushions covered in premium, fade-resistant fabric. Choose from classic Navy Blue, Mint Green, Light Blue, or Beige options to match your decor. The patio set cushions provide firm yet soft support, with anti-slip bottoms to keep them in place.

【Stylish & Functional Center Coffee Table】 Complemented by a tempered glass or solid-finished coffee table, this set adds both style and practicality. The smooth tabletop is heat-resistant, easy to clean, and perfect for placing drinks, snacks, or books. It elevates the modern aesthetic of your black rattan furniture.

【Easy Assembly & Low Maintenance】 All necessary hardware, clear instructions, and labeled parts are included for quick assembly. The weather-resistant wicker and removable, washable cushion covers require minimal upkeep—simply wipe down the wicker and toss the covers in the wash for effortless maintenance.
